audience.primary: Digital readers and remote workers seeking eye comfort
secondary: Parents buying a device for kids' reading/homework
audience.awarenessStage: Problem aware (digital eye strain, glossy screen glare)

primaryJob.statement: When working or reading on a tablet for hours, I want to avoid eye strain and glare, so I can stay productive without headaches or fatigue.
primaryJob.functional: Display readable text and video without harsh reflections or blue light flicker.
primaryJob.emotional: Feel calm and focused rather than wired and overstimulated by a glossy screen.
primaryJob.social: Look studious and professional using a paper-like device instead of a flashy iPad.

push: Glossy tablet screens cause distracting reflections indoors and outdoors.
PWM dimming causes invisible flicker leading to eye muscle fatigue.
Standard backlights disrupt sleep cycles when reading at night.
pull: TÜV-certified low blue light and flicker-free technology.
Large 14-inch screen allows split-screen productivity in a portable form factor.
anxieties: Is the matte screen only a gimmick? Will it look washed out or low-res?
A 14-inch tablet might be too heavy to hold for reading in bed.
Battery might drain quickly with max brightness.
habits: Buyers instinctively compare any tablet to the baseline iPad screen clarity.
Users rarely manually enable 'Reading Mode' or 'Eye Comfort Shield' every time they read.
Users hold tablets in one hand while lying on the sofa.

objections.objection: Matte screens look hazy and reduced sharpness compared to glossy.
objections.source: General market assumption for anti-glare coatings
objections.answer: NXTPAPER 3.0 uses advanced nano-etching to diffuse glare without the 'oil slick' rainbow grain seen in matte screen protectors.
objections.bustingVisual: Macro_lens: Slide between glossy iPad (reflection) and NXTPAPER (matte but crisp text). Overlay: 'Same resolution, zero grain'.

objections.objection: 14-inch is too big and heavy to hold comfortably.
objections.source: Habit of reading on smaller Kindles/iPad Minis
objections.answer: True holding comfort depends on weight distribution and thickness, not just screen size. This sits in the lap or case stand for extended reading.
objections.bustingVisual: POV_use: Lying on sofa, tablet rests on lap/knees, clear view of large text.

objections.objection: Battery won't last a full day of work/classes.
objections.source: Anxiety about Android tablet battery optimization
objections.answer: E-ink-like 'Paper Mode' drastically cuts display power draw compared to standard LCD. Full-day reading is achievable at medium brightness.
objections.bustingVisual: Time_lapse: Start with 100%, fast forward through 8 hours of page-turning, end at 15%+.

competitorGaps.gap: iPad lacks a true matte screen option without a sticky, low-quality screen protector.
competitorGaps.evidence: Apple iPad Nano-texture glass only available on $2000+ iPad Pro 13-inch.
competitorGaps.ourProof: NXTPAPER 14 offers matte display natively at $349.

competitorGaps.gap: E-Ink tablets (Kindle Scribe, Remarkable) have slow refresh rates and cannot play video.
competitorGaps.evidence: E-Ink devices struggle with color accuracy and dynamic content.
competitorGaps.ourProof: NXTPAPER 14 plays smooth, full-color video while still mimicking paper for reading.

complianceNotes.rule: Strike-through price ($469.99) must have been a genuine, non-transient former price.
complianceNotes.action: Verify the duration and history of the $469.99 listing price before publishing. Do not use 'Was $469.99' if it was only sold at this price for a few seconds during launch.

complianceNotes.rule: Do not claim 'prevents eye strain' or 'eliminates headaches'. Use safe, certifiable language.
complianceNotes.action: Strictly stick to 'TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light and Flicker Free certified' and 'diffuses glare' without making medical guarantees.

complianceNotes.rule: 'Up to 10 hours' needs qualifying conditions to avoid misrepresentation.
complianceNotes.action: Mandatory visual disclaimer or voiceover clarification: 'Battery life varies. 10 hours based on internal TCL testing using Paper Mode at 150 nits.'
